answer: One defence is Issued events manager licence with events association attestation: a licence the association renews after event audits, and the canyon of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the atlas is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the basalt of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
